title: Pentagon
subtitle: Five equal sides
description: A regular pentagon, point up: five equal sides, the apex at the top, a flat base 0.618 of the node across, and its widest row at the two upper vertices rather than at the bottom.

Regular proportions, fitted like every other shape -- it fills the node's width and is 0.951 of it tall, so the angles are the pentagon's own rather than stretched to fill a square. Its mass is at the base and the apex is empty, so the item's anchor sits three percent of the node below the middle, where the material is.
